evidence.V1: Reads as a coursed stone wall section from front and three-quarter; silhouette and top are a clean slab as a modular piece should be.
evidence.V2: Clear hierarchy: wall slab, medium cap/plinth/courses, small chamfers and recessed joints.
evidence.V3: Stones are near-square uniform tiles with thin sliver stones at the left edge; tidy but stiff rather than confidently stylised.
evidence.V4: Consistent small chamfers on every stone, cap and plinth that catch the light in the face and top close-ups.
evidence.V5: Face, top and end-section close-ups are clean: no pinches, seams or z-fighting.
evidence.V6: One stone hue in ~3 grey values with a darker plinth; brick and sandstone colourways keep the value structure.
evidence.V7: 572 tris vs module target 800 - under target.
evidence.V8: One vertex-colour material, chamfered made-object edges, stone hue in 3 values; matches the modular kit spec.
evidence.V9: Anchored, Box collision, CanTouch off, Color white, grid-corner pivot; T1 tiling passes (iou 0.98, cover 1.0).

top_fixes: Vary stone widths more and avoid thin sliver stones at the panel edge
Add slight per-stone inset/bulge or edge irregularity for stylised character
Consider wrapping stone joints onto the plain end face
